Ava: If Redwood had a made-up company holiday, what would it be called and what's the ritual? Silly, non-work answers only :sparkles:
Leo: Coder Carnival? Everyone brings one weird USB stick from home and we swap them :joy:
Priya: I nominate 'Snacksgiving' — communal snack table, each person brings one tiny thing, blind taste test for best chip :chipmunk: :trophy:
Miguel: We'd need an official chant. `for throughput and snacks` :drum:
Sana: Holiday: 'Commitmas' — we write one fake commit message praising a teammate, then spin the wheel for prizes :santa:
Jamie: Can we have a mini-parade of desk plants? 'Plants on Parade' :seedling: :parade_ground:
Ava: Love the plant parade. Ritual: decorate a plant with tiny sticky notes of appreciation. :heart_eyes:
Leo: Also a mandatory 15-min 'no Zoom' walk outside. Vote? :raised_hands:
Priya: 100% yes. Adding: dessert potluck. I'll bring empanadas.
remind-bot: Poll: Which holiday should we try this quarter? Options: 1) Coder Carnival 2) Snacksgiving 3) Commitmas 4) Plants on Parade. Vote with :one: :two: :three: :four:
Miguel: Voted :four: — does my plant get a name tag? 'Kung Pao'
Sana: If Snacksgiving wins I will bring my secret family dip recipe. Warning: dangerously addictive.
Jamie: If Commitmas wins we need a trophy made of sticky notes.
Ava: Congratulations team — new unofficial holiday planning thread to follow if poll gets >5 votes :tada:
